items.markdown:
Travelling to Thailand `requires planning for visa rules, health precautions, and local safety guidelines` . Key preparation steps include checking your visa status, completing digital arrival forms, and getting recommended vaccinations.[](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/overseas-travel/advice/thailand/) [[1]](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/overseas-travel/advice/thailand/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iUpSB646_oQ&t=507)

Entry and Documents

- **Visas:** Many tourists receive a visa-exempt stay upon arrival (up to 60 days for select nationalities), but rules can change. Check current rules via the Royal Thai Embassy before you fly.
- **Arrival Form:** Complete the mandatory digital arrival form online shortly before your trip.
- **Passports:** Must be valid for at least 6 months with no severe damage, or entry may be denied.[](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/overseas-travel/advice/thailand/) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/travel-to-thailand/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk)

Health and Food

- **Water:** Never drink tap water; use bottled water for drinking and brushing teeth.
- **Vaccines:** Consult a travel clinic or doctor weeks prior for routine shots, Hepatitis A, and Typhoid.
- **Mosquitoes:** Pack strong insect repellent to prevent dengue fever and other mosquito-borne illnesses.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iUpSB646_oQ&t=507) [[1]](https://www.responsibletravel.com/holidays/thailand/travel-guide/thailand-travel-advice)

Safety and Laws

- **Vaping:** E-cigarettes and vaping devices are strictly illegal in Thailand.
- **Transport:** Exercise extreme caution when renting scooters or using tuk-tuks, and use licensed ride-hailing apps like Grab or Bolt.
- **Customs:** Dress modestly when visiting temples (cover shoulders and knees) and show high respect for the Thai Royal Family.[](https://theroamingrenegades.com/thailand-travel-tips/) [[1]](https://theroamingrenegades.com/thailand-travel-tips/)[[2]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thailand-travel-advice/)[[3]](https://wise.com/gb/blog/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/TS7isi4HNL8)
